mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS ( SELECT
FROM base_region_info bri WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT bri2.id, bri2.parent_id, bri2.name, bri2.code, bri2.levels, bri2.full_name, bri2.full_id FROM base_region_info bri2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = bri2.parent_id ) SELECT *, bri2.name as parent_name FROM child_nodes ch left join base_region_info bri2 on ch.parent_id = bri2.id where ch.levels = #{levels};

WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS ( SELECT
FROM base_region_info bri WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT bri2.id, bri2.parent_id, bri2.name, bri2.code, bri2.levels, bri2.full_name, bri2.full_id FROM base_region_info bri2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = bri2.parent_id ) SELECT *, bri2.name as parent_name FROM child_nodes ch left join base_region_info bri2 on ch.parent_id = bri2.id

WITH RECURSIVE parent_nodes AS ( SELECT
FROM base_region_info bri WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT bri2.id, bri2.parent_id, bri2.name, bri2.code, bri2.levels, bri2.full_name, bri2.full_id FROM base_region_info bri2 JOIN parent_nodes pn ON pn.parent_id = bri2.id ) SELECT *, bri2.name as parent_name FROM parent_nodes pn left join base_region_info bri2 on pn.parent_id = bri2.id
